New to Walking is Mick Graham, one of the Club's Cross Country and Road Running stalwarts. Mick is already knocking on the door of future Veteran Representation and he says that he finds the friendship around the country in the Walking scene very refreshing.
To add to the successes of day, Mick Graham (M45) gained a 7th place in the Seniors 10km and is fast becoming a force in the Veteran Races around the country.

Mick Graham has been taking part in our cross country and road races for years. With his son Paul showing an early aptitude for all sports but in particular those of running and walking, it was natural that Belgrave should soon take on another recruit.

Nice too, to have Derek Clack back in the team while the ever eager Mick Graham will do anything to get on the score sheet - but that was it as far as 800m, 1500m and 3000m and steeplechase were concerned - for both age groups.

"Suffolk" Mick Graham has recently passed the first stage of his Race Walking coaching examination; we hear that he is well on the way towards qualifying as a judge as well.
Mick Graham, father of the current U13 National Champion, Paul Graham, is another fast improver having recorded his first sub 15 minute 3 km walk at the 1997 Belgrave track championships.

Finally thanks must go to those seniors who have helped coach our youngsters to their present high standard. They include Mabon Dane, Mick Graham, Dave Sharpe and Ray Hall. I look forward to another successful year.
